snippet.title: Little Witch in the Woods – Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Start your life as an apprentice alongside Ellie, the little witch!
Explore a mysterious forest, gather ingredients, brew potions, help the villagers, go fishing, decorate your space, and spend time with cats.

Little Witch in the Woods is available now on XBOX.
